finite_set_type_safety_followup.cause: The initial repair rewrote a finite solution list as parenthesized notation, which Math-Verify parses as an open interval. It rejected valid reversed solution lists. The library also deliberately aliases open intervals to coordinate pairs, so a separate type guard is needed for finite-set references.
finite_set_type_safety_followup.repair: Normalize only comma spacing of a bare numeric candidate list when the reference is an explicitly spaced list. Keep the reference's finite-set parse, reject interval candidates for finite-set references, and do not enable set-relation aliases for finite-set references. The legacy comparison branch is unchanged.
finite_set_type_safety_followup.preserved: All 40 complete historical replay grade objects are unchanged: 30 semantic acceptances, all legacy grades preserved, zero verifier errors. Grouped integer notation still works against an integer reference; intervals, inequalities, partial sets, extra members, and concatenated scalars do not substitute for the two-member solution set.
